newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Indian BOP talks suspended at WTO to June 30.
newsitem.headline: Indian BOP talks suspended at WTO to June 30.

text.p: Indian's talks with other members of the World Trade Organisation (WTO) on lifting balance-of-payment import restrictions were on Wednesday suspended until June 30, trade officials said.
They said the suspension of the troubled talks, which had been due to wrap up later in the day, had been decided to give all participants "a period of reflection."

But the decision came after major developed trading powers made clear they could not accept an Indian proposal to lift the long-standing curbs, which affect some 2,700 items including consumer goods and farm produce, over nine years.

Diplomats said earlier the Indian delegation to the talks, headed by Secretary of Commerce P.P.Prabhu, appeared to have little room for manoeuvre and was unlikely to be able to compromise without further detailed discussions in Delhi.
